closed_definitions.BASIC_CARD_COMPLETE: At the physical/scoped card level: verified name/card proof plus read Basic pane pages and a closed category-specific display-field-state inventory: each declared field has an observed value/custody or explicit absence from all observed Basic pages. No unresolved literal. New1853 cards use visually reviewed top/bottom pane coverage. This is display completeness only; no fixed20-field requirement or intrinsic absence inferred.
closed_definitions.BASIC_CARD_PARTIAL: Basic properties/proofs exist, but explicit display absence/applicability/closure metadata is not qualified. Next action NEEDS_OFFLINE_QUALIFICATION, not automatic GUI recapture.
closed_definitions.ALL_APPLICABLE_PANELS_COMPLETE: Basic complete plus qualified applicable-panel inventory and complete independently scrolling trade lists, or actual proof of inapplicability. A first panel, raw NPC export or empty visible viewport alone is insufficient.
closed_definitions.OTERYN_IMPORT_READY: Qualified physical-card to canonical variant/server identity, qualified field applicability, accepted lossless unit conversion and source/version provenance; no unresolved variant conflict. Name-only and icon-only candidates cannot satisfy this.
closed_definitions.COHORT_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED: Current-client physical-card to appearance binding is not qualified. This is separate from canonical/server import authority; accepted Hats singletons are not held merely because server IDs remain unqualified.
closed_definitions.CLIENT_BASIC_COMPLETE: Basic-card-complete physical record plus explicitly accepted current-client appearance namespace binding. Canonical/server-ID authority is not required for this Cyclopedia display scope.

states.OBSERVED_VALUE: Known display value, including known zero.
states.ABSENT_IN_ALL_OBSERVED_BASIC_PAGES: Known absence from observed complete Basic panel; not intrinsic false/zero/NA.
states.FIELD_ABSENT_IN_LOCAL_RECORD: Known static source absence, not an uncollected GUI requirement.
states.APPLICABILITY_NOT_QUALIFIED: Held; no invented default or forced field requirement.
states.NEEDS_OFFLINE_QUALIFICATION: Recover metadata/proof/custody from existing files first.
states.NEEDS_IDENTITY_QUALIFICATION: Resolve explicit identity/variant relationships, not a request for arbitrary new screenshots.
